name: GAIA2
titleZh: Gaia2：在动态异步环境中评测 LLM 智能体
summary: Scenarios where the environment evolves independently of the agent, forcing it to cope with time constraints, noisy events, ambiguity and collaboration.
summaryZh: 环境会独立于智能体自行演化，迫使它应对时间限制、噪声事件、歧义以及与其它智能体协作。
keyFact: Gaia2 (Froger et al., arXiv:2602.11964, 2026-02-12) pairs every scenario with a write-action verifier for action-level scoring, and reports that no evaluated model dominates across capabilities.
keyFactZh: Gaia2（Froger 等，arXiv:2602.11964，2026-02-12）为每个场景配了「写操作校验器」来做动作级评分，并报告没有任何一个被测模型在所有能力上都占优。
whyItMatters: The write-action verifier makes it directly usable for reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards; a benchmark doubling as a training environment is the notable part.
whyItMattersZh: 「写操作校验器」让它能直接用作可验证奖励的强化学习环境——基准同时充当训练环境，这才是值得注意的地方。
title: Gaia2: Benchmarking LLM Agents on Dynamic and Asynchronous Environments
